kena_chapter4_verse1.title: Kena Chapter 4 Verse 1
kena_chapter4_verse1.introduction: This verse belongs to Kena, Chapter 4.
kena_chapter4_verse1.scripture_text: A representative contemplative passage from the Kena Upanishad, Chapter 4, Verse 1, reflecting the inquiry into Atman, Brahman, and liberation through self-knowledge.
kena_chapter4_verse1.philosophical_explanation: This verse extends the contemplative teaching tradition of the Upanishads toward self-knowledge and liberation.
